summary.product_claim: After ordinary teaching events, Kivi rewrites the user's words in new transcripts, and deliberately does nothing when its evidence is weak, wrong, or silenced.
summary.model_usage: none - phonetic matching is fully local; the memory layer makes no LLM calls

baseline_comparison.description: Naive baseline: rewrite whenever any taught word has similarity >= 0.72. No candidate lifecycle, no real-word veto, no context boost, no needs_review, no suppression.

cases.note: Runs against a candidate-only word; candidates never rewrite.
